description: Korean unemployment benefit after voluntary resignation: checks the justified reasons in 고용보험법 시행규칙 별표 2 (amended 2024-07-01). Item 1 (worse conditions, unpaid wages, below minimum wage, overtime limit violations, shutdown pay under 70%) counts only if it lasted 2+ months within the year before leaving; commuting needs 3+ hours round trip; family care needs 30+ days and refused leave; health and pregnancy/childcare need refused leave or transfer. Also checks 180 insured days in the 18 months before leaving (제40조). Returns per-reason results with evidence to bring; the employment center decides.

commuteHours.description: Round-trip commute hours after the change, by ordinary transport

insuredDays.description: Insured (paid) days in the 18 months before leaving

leaveRefused.description: The employer refused leave, a leave of absence or a job transfer

months.description: Months within the year before leaving that an item-1 reason lasted
